task.title: Add a New Phone to Duo
task.shortdesc: Reconnect or transfer Duo authentication when replacing, losing, or upgrading your phone.

prereq.p: Before you begin, make sure you have the following:

ul.li: Your NC State Unity ID and password
Access to text messages on the phone number currently registered with Duo
The Duo Mobile app installed on your new phone

context.p: Use these steps if you used the Duo Mobile app on your old phone and kept the same phone number. Complete the browser steps on a computer so you can scan the activation QR code with your new phone.

ul.li: If you only received verification codes by text message and kept the same phone number, no action is required; your text codes will continue automatically.
If your phone number changed, contact the NC State Help Desk at 919-515-4357 (HELP) to register your new number.

step.cmd: On your computer, open a web browser and go to https://docs.shib.ncsu.edu/duoenroll/.
Sign in with your NC State Unity ID and password.
Leave the Passcode field empty and select Enter a Passcode.
Select Text me new codes in the blue box at the bottom of the page.

stepresult.p: Duo sends a verification code via text message to your phone.

step.cmd: Enter the texted verification code into the Login field and select Log in.

stepresult.p: The My Settings and Device page opens.

step.cmd: Select Device Options next to your old phone entry.

stepresult.p: An activation QR code appears on your computer screen.

step.cmd: Open the Duo Mobile app on your new phone, follow the prompts to add an account, and scan the QR code displayed on your computer screen.

result.p: Your new phone is active for Duo authentication, and you can use the Duo Mobile app to receive verification codes.
